root: ^He stands at the edge of the water, unmoving. He doesn’t look at you when you approach. Go away. Silence stretches between you. His voice is lower when he speaks again.
^Sheila used to like this place. Said the water was always calm, even when everything else was a mess. His hands tighten into fists before he shakes his head.
^She’s gone now. And there’s nothing I can do about it. For once, there’s no anger in his tone—only grief.
